result.question: What is photosynthesis and what are its main stages?
result.answer: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy in photosynthetic organisms [1]. Light-dependent reactions generate ATP and NADPH and release oxygen from water [2]. The Calvin cycle uses ATP and NADPH to fix carbon dioxide into carbohydrates [3].

result.question: How do transformer-based language models handle long context windows?
result.answer: Self-attention relates tokens throughout the available context window [1]. Dense attention has quadratic attention-score cost as sequence length grows [2]. Sparse attention and positional-encoding adaptations can extend useful context, with accuracy and memory trade-offs [3].

result.question: What were the main causes of the 2008 financial crisis?
result.answer: Risky mortgage lending and falling housing prices increased mortgage defaults [1]. Securitization and high leverage transmitted mortgage losses through financial institutions [2]. Uncertainty about counterparties and funding runs amplified the financial crisis [3].

result.question: What is the current state of fusion energy research?
result.answer: Fusion research studies how light nuclei can combine and release energy under suitable conditions [1]. Magnetic and inertial confinement are two major experimental approaches [2]. A scientific energy-gain result is distinct from a power plant delivering net electricity to the grid [3].

result.question: How does CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing work at a molecular level?
result.answer: A guide RNA directs Cas9 toward a complementary DNA sequence near a compatible PAM [1]. Cas9 can cut the DNA strands at the targeted site [2]. Cellular DNA repair can introduce sequence changes or use a supplied repair template [3].
